text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: One day, when I came to watch a race――

text_block_list.name: Commentary
text_block_list.text:
GOOOOOOAL! After a blistering dead heat, 
the one who finally seizes victory is――

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text:
Amaaazing! Racing really is so thrilling! 
Oh, right, since we're here, let's take a 
commemorative photo――

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text:
Ah, you over there! Would you mind taking 
a photo of me?

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text:
Make sure you can see the racetrack! 
Countin' on ya~!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
And so, swept along by the momentum, I 
took a photo of Fine Motion――

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text:
Whoa, what a wonderful photo! This is... 
yup, a three-leaf memory clover for sure!

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text:
I absolutely love clovers. Whenever 
something wonderful happens, I use them to 
keep score.

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text:
Before I head back to Ireland, I want to 
collect lots of clovers in this country, 
too.

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text:
Outside my homeland, a world I've never 
seen! I don't want to forget such a 
wonderful experience♪ That's why I'm 
taking tons of pictures.

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text:
Right? Where do you think we should go 
next to find a wonderful photo op?

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text:
I see! The finish line is finally closing 
in, and you're sizing up the exact moment 
to make your move!

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text:
Seeing everyone come into view as they 
round the corner has such incredible 
power! It always blows me away!

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text:
Yup. If we can get a pretty picture, it'll 
make such a wonderful memory~♪

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text:
Aah~! Squeezing out their last ounce of 
strength, everyone's running desperately 
to win!

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text:
Yeah, that sounds like it'll be a 
wonderful memory! Now I'm really looking 
forward to it.

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text:
Then I gotta find a spot with great 
lighting. Wonder if over there would be 
better?
